findings_and_reconciliations.trace: The current capture query admits an optional LocomotionHeightState and substitutes HeightDistance::ZERO when it is absent. The landing gate obtains the maximum from all saved values and regards its final compression <=0.005 as settled. If earlier measured landing compression provides the required 0.04–0.08 peak while final height state is absent, that absent last observation is represented as zero and can satisfy the final settled predicate. In P17 the sample preserves absent compression and landing_response_valid rejects any landing frame missing that observation.
